sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety, then selected UCM after excluding recent duplicates.
Read arXiv metadata, full PDF text, appendix tables, WASP evaluation, and official repository README.
Explained DOM masking, Q-Model typed interface, trust-boundary inference, WebArena setup, and data-flow limitations.
Separated control-flow guarantees from data-flow risks and highlighted mislabeling, free-text fallback, and deployment limits.
Compared UCM with heuristic detection, prompt defense, typed API planning, dual LLM, WASP, CaMeL, and FIDES-style lines.
Article uses pure Markdown with TLDR, tables, formula blocks, pseudocode, and Mermaid; no external images embedded.
